Title: Spell of Life and Redeem the Lost Soul

Messages.Author: smithheroldson
Messages.Body:
I was wondering after one of your big fat spell of life mummies hits
the ash heap can you play Redeem on it?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
smithheroldson wrote:
> I was wondering after one of your big fat spell of life mummies hits
> the ash heap can you play Redeem on it?

Yes*, the card in your ash heap is a vampire in your ash heap.

*Unless the card isn't a vampire in your ash heap -- for example, if your
Embrace vampire were Banished and then Spell of Lifed and then burned.
